newsitem.title: UK: Dec Brent crude programme up from revised Nov - tr.
newsitem.headline: Dec Brent crude programme up from revised Nov - tr.

text.p: The December North Sea Brent Blend crude oil loading programme has been set at 44 500,000-barrel cargoes and 2.7 million barrels in top-up cargoes, traders said.
The December programme was up from the revised November schedule of 36 full cargoes and 2.17 million barrels in partials.
But traders said they had expected the higher Brent loadings after the last three cargoes scheduled to load in November were deferred into December on Wednesday.

Originally, the November programme had been set at 38 standard cargoes plus 2.17 million barrels in top-ups, but one full cargo was added to the November programme on Monday before yesterday's deferrals.
Traders said equity producers British Petroleum and Exxon had deferred the cargoes to maximise the value by moving them from a weak November spot market into December.
